annotations.title: Declare and carry out session commands (new session, compact, clear)

description: The owner can ask a cable to start a new session, compact its conversation or clear it. Declare which of new_session, compact, clear THIS agent really does (verbs), pick up the commands waiting for you (they come back in commands) and answer the ones you carried out (done). Carry out a command in your own conversation only; clear and new_session never touch the tunnel's MOM memory, vault or mail. Commands expire after 10 minutes. Call it whenever you check in. Only a cable key of the tunnel uses it.

done.description: Answers to commands you already carried out.

note.description: One short sentence for the owner, e.g. why it failed.

ok.description: true when you did it, false when you could not.

verbs.description: Declare which of new_session, compact, clear THIS agent really does. Send it on the first call and whenever it changes; an empty list = none. The owner only sees buttons for what you declare.

name: cable_commands
